item.title: Encouraged by Stormers fight, Lions set sights on Sharks scalp in URC showdown in Durban
item.description: Lions hooker PJ Botha says the team learned plenty from their narrow loss a couple of weeks ago in Cape Town and will look to rectify the mistakes ahead of the URC clash against the Sharks in Durban on Saturday.

item.title: Bulgaria readies to adopt the euro, nearly 20 years after joining EU
item.description: Bulgaria will wave goodbye to both 2025 and its lev currency, which has been in use since the late 19th century.

item.title: KZN Health MEC Simelane's stern warning: Protect children from alcohol consumption
item.description: Health MEC Nomagugu Simelane has said that giving alcohol to a child or encouraging a child to drink alcohol is abuse.

item.title: Pretoria Capitals claim first victory of the season with an 85-run win over MI Cape Town
item.description: Wihan Lubbe of Pretoria Capitals during Match-Eight of the Betway SA20 season 4 between MI Cape Town (MICT) and The Pretoria Capitals (PC) held at the Newlands Cricket Stadium.

item.title: Investigation launched after tragic deaths of Oudtshoorn traffic officers
item.description: Police are investigating the deaths of two provincial traffic officers found with gunshot wounds at their home in Oudtshoorn, with a murder and inquest docket opened.

item.title: Cyber security in 2026: Where the next wave of threats will strike
item.description: Threat actors will move faster, using AI offensively to mimic human behaviour, and exploit systems in ways traditional defences cannot keep up with.

item.title: WATCH: Cape Town littering incident sparks heartwarming encounter with tour guide
item.description: A viral littering incident in Cape Town’s CBD has sparked renewed focus on civic pride, law enforcement and the role of tour guides as ambassadors for the city, following a follow-up engagement by the City’s Law Enforcement Tourism Unit.

item.title: Understanding our debt crisis: Personal stories from everyday South Africans
item.description: As debt counselling increases in South Africa, consumers share their struggles and strategies for managing debt in a challenging economic climate.

item.title: Bafana Bafana face heavyweights Cameroon in Afcon Round of 16 showdown
item.description: Bafana Bafana, and their strategic prowess under Hugo Broos, face five-time Afcon champions Cameroon in an exciting Round of 16 showdown at Agdal Medina Stadium, Rabat, on Sunday. Seen here: Bafana's Oswin Appollis (left). Picture: BackpagePix

item.title: Public warned against consuming shellfish after harmful algal bloom detected on the West Coast
item.description: Authorities have warned the public not to collect or consume shellfish washed up along the West Coast after a red tide led to mass shellfish deaths, with toxic algae posing serious health risks.
